newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends a shade weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends a shade weaker vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended Friday trade weaker against the dollar.
The forint ended right on the central bank bid at 155.68/73 to one dollar, compared with 155.53/59 at the opening.
Dealers said they did not expect much change next week in a generally quiet domestic picture.

"Apart from the usual end-of-month currency buying, the only factor likely to disturb things would be a one-off purchase by a large client," said Noemi Koppendorfer of Magyar Hitel Bank, adding that this was not something one could easily predict.
